body:
UWELL Caliburn GPP Pods is a Caliburn replacement part made for adults who already own a compatible device. Swapping in a fresh pod or coil restores flavor and keeps your setup running the way it did on day one.

UWELL Caliburn GPP Pods is listed at $10.99 in our Coils & Pods range. Every product on the site is stocked for adults aged 21 and over, and you can browse the full [Coils & Pods](/shop/coils-pods/) collection to compare it with similar options.

## Flavor and experience
The name UWELL GPP points to a flavor that is easy to recognize. Flavor is personal, so treat the description as a guide rather than a promise: how a profile tastes depends on your device, how you draw and what you vaped before.

## Specifications
- **Brand:** Caliburn
- **Category:** Coils & Pods
- **Flavor:** UWELL GPP
- **Price:** $10.99
- **Ships from:** Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse
- **Age requirement:** 21+ with adult signature on delivery

## Key features and what they mean for you
- **Designed to match the original device:** so it fits securely and connects without adapters.
- **Quick swap:** takes seconds and needs no tools or cleaning.

## Who it suits
UWELL Caliburn GPP Pods suits adult owners of the matching device who want to keep it running, and anyone who prefers to stock spares so they never run out.

## Using and caring for it
Confirm the product name matches your device before ordering, because pods and coils are not interchangeable between brands. Remove the old part, press the new one in until it seats, and let it rest for a minute before use. Dispose of used parts responsibly, store spares in a cool dry place, and keep them out of reach of children and pets.

## Ordering, payment and delivery
You can order UWELL Caliburn GPP Pods online with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Pay with crypto or a supported gift card and you save 10% on your order total. Orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; below that, shipping is a flat $15, and the minimum order is $100.

Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by USPS or UPS. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so make sure someone of age can receive the parcel.

## Returns and support
Our returns window is 30 days from purchase. Unopened products in their original packaging qualify, refunds are issued through the same payment method that was used for the order, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be accepted. Contact us first so we can send an RMA form. Read the full [refund policy](/refunds/) and [shipping policy](/shipping/), or visit the [FAQ](/faq/) for more answers.
